card.name: Dosing and treatment-schedule instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or numbers inside dosing and treatment-duration sentences, such as "to" in "without regard to timing of meals" or "be" in "should be taken". It fires where the sentence is about when or how long to take a drug.

modes.label: Meal timing and administration
modes.description: Linking word within an instruction on when to take a drug relative to meals.
modes.example: Meloxicam may be taken without regard<< to>> timing of meals.

modes.label: Duration and course of treatment
modes.description: Word or comma in a sentence about continuing, stopping, or withdrawing treatment.
modes.example: Progressive withdrawal<< of>> insulin and increase of glyburide tablets

modes.label: Numbers in dose targets
modes.description: A number ending a range in a treatment goal or dose.
modes.example: the subjective goal in proper treatment is to produce 2 to <<3>> soft stools daily.

card.plain: It marks the small connecting words in sentences telling how and when to take or stop a medicine.
